crossRefs.note: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
translations.bsb: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
translations.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
translations.asv: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
